nc.description: A light grey 3D model features a central cylindrical pillar topped with a rounded cap that is breaking apart into several fragments.
A monochromatic 3D rendering displays a static mechanical assembly consisting of a cylindrical shaft, a central coupling joint, and a section resembling a crankshaft.
A plain, light gray 3D model of a hole punch rests on a white background.
A light grey mechanical arm with gears and three articulated fingers is positioned above a detached, slightly curved cylindrical component.
Various light grey mechanical components are arranged symmetrically around a central white X-shaped piece on a white background.

vc.description: A light grey mechanical stand with a central pole and a segmented base resting on ribbed feet features a broken threaded collar.
A light grey mechanical assembly featuring a textured knob, articulated joints, and circular pads is shown with a threaded cap detached on the right side.
A close-up shows a grey mechanical hinge connecting two molded handles to a flat, textured rectangular base.
A mechanical hand assembly is connected to a disassembled cylindrical structure featuring separated threaded rings and a cracked base.
An assembled mechanical device with exposed gears is centered among its disassembled casing parts and various individual gears arranged on a white background.
